Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
Can you remind me, or send me the link, of all the rules and clarifications
for Blood and Wild Hunt. When can you call a Blood Hunt ? What delay do you
have to call it ? Who can cast votes ? Who can't ? When does the burning of
the vampire takes effect ? etc. etc.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Rafid Armani wrote:
>
> Can you remind me, or send me the link, of all the rules and clarifications
> for Blood and Wild Hunt. When can you call a Blood Hunt ? What delay do you
> have to call it ? Who can cast votes ? Who can't ? When does the burning of
> the vampire takes effect ? etc. etc.

See section 6.5.6. of the revised rules (see .sig for starting point).

Answers to above questions:
Anyone.
No delay (must be called immediately, or not at all). It is called after
the diablerie - after the skill card (if any) is placed, etc.
Anyone.
No one.
The vamp is burned when (and if) the referendum passes.

etc.:
Action Modifiers and Reaction cards cannot be used during the Blood Hunt.
